# Passenger Survey Results: Bus Network

Unit: Bus Network Redesign Project
Period: 2 to 13 June 2025
Respondents: 1,200

## 1. Busiest route in the passengers' view

Respondents were asked which route they find most overcrowded at peak hours.

| Route | Share of respondents |
|---|---:|
| Route 7 | 41% |
| Route 12 | 27% |
| Route 3 | 14% |
| Other routes | 18% |

Result: Route 7 has the largest share.

## 2. Overall satisfaction

Average overall satisfaction with the bus service: 3.1 out of 5.

## 3. Most requested improvements (multiple choice)

- Shorter waits at peak hours: 58%
- Real-time bus arrival information: 35%
- Cleaner buses and better ventilation: 22%
- Electric and quieter buses: 19%

## 4. Limitations

The survey was held at main stops in the morning and evening, so off-peak travellers are under-represented.
